reproduction_target: snRNA-seq computational analysis of iPSC-derived forebrain organoids (WT vs FNDC4 KO, 3 lines x 3 timepoints): Parse Biosciences split-pipe (v1.4.0) FASTQ->counts alignment to hg38 + demultiplex, then Seurat (v5.0.3, R 4.3.2) QC/integration/UMAP clustering/FindAllMarkers, ScType cell-type annotation, and Monocle3 (v1.3.7) trajectory/pseudotime. Input raw data in GEO GSE285126. Wet-lab organoid generation is upstream (W layer, OOS for computational reproduction).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the snRNA-seq Data Analysis prose. No code/script repository or code-availability statement exists; every C-layer step therefore has code axis capped at 1 (named public tool + invocation described, no shared script). Wet-lab procedures counted in W, not verdicted (layer W). Stage-1 prose-only: no code executed, no workflow source read.

steps.label: Parse Biosciences split-pipe pipeline (v1.4.0), default settings: align snRNA-seq FASTQ reads to human genome (hg38) + demultiplex samples

Seurat (v5.0.3) in R (v4.3.2): filter genes <100 nuclei / nuclei <500 genes, 2000 variable features, 9-sample integration + anchor genes, UMAP unsupervised clustering (resolution 0.5, 15 clusters), FindAllMarkers (Bonferroni p<0.05, |log2FC|>1)
ScType cell-type annotation of clusters using prior neural organoid reference datasets (no version recorded)
Monocle3 (v1.3.7) trajectory/pseudotime, per-sample: resolution 3e-5 (all pooled) / 3e-3 (WT, KOc2, KOc5 alone), root cluster set in Neural Progenitor Cell cluster(s)

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 3/4 computational steps (C1 split-pipe, C2 Seurat, C4 Monocle3), each carrying an exact version pin (v1.4.0 / v5.0.3+R4.3.2 / v1.3.7). No code/script is shared and no environment lock/container is claimed, so R★ is NOT assignable even in principle from this paper as written — stage2 could at best raise these to R★ if a reproducer reconstructs the pinned environment and the tools' default/stated invocations suffice. C3 (ScType, no version) caps at NI.
headline.coverage: 4 computational (snRNA-seq analysis) steps assessed from Methods prose; ~7 wet-lab steps counted (W) but out of computational-reproduction scope. No code repository exists to read.

gaps.where: Whole snRNA-seq Data Analysis section; paper has a DATA AVAILABILITY statement (GEO GSE285126) but NO code-availability statement and no GitHub/Zenodo/GitLab repository.
gaps.missing: No analysis scripts/notebooks shared. Reproduction of the Seurat/ScType/Monocle3 downstream analysis relies entirely on re-implementing from prose (filter thresholds, integration, clustering resolution, marker filters, pseudotime roots).
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the R analysis scripts / Rmd + split-pipe config to a public repo (GitHub + Zenodo DOI) with a run order and session info.

gaps.where: R/Bioconductor environment for C1-C4 (split-pipe v1.4.0, R 4.3.2, Seurat 5.0.3, Monocle3 1.3.7, ScType).
gaps.missing: No lockfile (renv.lock/conda-lock), no container, no environment.yml. Versions appear only inline in prose for 4 of 5 tools; ScType and all transitive dependencies are unpinned; OS/system-lib closure unspecified.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship renv.lock or a container digest for a declared platform; stage2 should resolve the full dependency closure and platform coverage.

gaps.where: C2/C4 down-sampling and stochastic steps: 'random down-sampling ... using the sample() function', UMAP/integration and Monocle3 pseudotime.

gaps.how_to_close: Report set.seed() values and record which down-sampled subsets underlie each reported comparison/figure.

gaps.missing: Prose describes 9 samples (3 iPSC lines x 3 timepoints d45/d90/d150) but the run/sample-sheet linking GEO records to WT/KOc2/KOc5 x timepoint and to split-pipe inputs is not in the prose read (relies on GEO metadata/supplement).
gaps.how_to_close: Provide a sample sheet mapping GEO/SRA accessions to line x timepoint and to the split-pipe sample config.
